items.detail: hsd_3A94.h declares hsd_804D2648 as __jmp_buf while definition is u8[0x828] and JPEG consumers cast it to JpegWork. Card consumers likewise overlay adjacent bulk symbols with CardContext. Definitions remain unchanged.
hsd_804D2E70 size/address is verified; direct semantic consumer role was not established in inspected card/JPEG ranges. Do not assign a specific buffer purpose.
Current named external relocation form independently confirmed. Counterfactual matching effect of merging TUs was not tested.
Owned comment says decoder, but inspected JpegWork consumer encodes JPEG components and emits JPEG output. Proposals use encoder.
